title: Macaroni
summary: MACARO'NI, noun [Gr. happy.] 1. A kind of biscuit made of flour, eggs, sugar and almonds, and dressed with butter and spices. 2. A sort of droll or fool, and hence, a fop; a fribble; a finical fellow.
